response.overview: 'A FANTASTIC gig!' – Roger Daltrey's own verdict after The Who completed an explosive curtain-raiser to the Peel Bay Festival.  There would be few in the 6,000-plus audience who would disagree. From the opening riffs of I Can't Explain to the anthemic Won't Get Fooled Again which closed the main set, the Who proved why they are truly one of the greatest rock acts in the world. Highlight of a night of highlights was the swirling majesty of Baba O'Riley – not even written the last time The Who played in the Isle of Man – and this was the moment when the near-capacity crowd knew they were listening to something really special.
response.title: The Who: Isle of Man 5/30/2007
